river_nest_doss_challenge.speaker: Doss
river_nest_doss_challenge._comment: T3-ACTIVITIES, spec sec6's 'River Nest: aggressive Water/Air creatures block a fishing location'. Same one-character-is-the-giver shape Old Bram established: the first line is the flag `revealed_by` waits on.

lines.text: Don't bother casting past the bend. Been trying to get that pair to settle for a week and they've decided the whole nest is theirs now.

lines: Every line I put in the water they take as a challenge. If you can put them in their place, the fishing's yours again -- and I'd genuinely like to see it done.

river_nest_doss_defeated.speaker: Doss
lines: Ha! That's the first quiet water I've seen off that bend all week.
Cast wherever you like now. I mean it -- you earned the spot more than I did.
